title: Signed Partitions for Maximal Tori
body_html:
Signed Partitions for Maximal Tori

A signed partition of a positive integer \(r\) is a partition of \(r\) together with a sign attached to each part.

Let \(S\) be a symplectic group of type \(C_r\) over \(k\). The construction from weight orbits associates to each maximal \(k\)-torus \(T\) a signed partition of \(r\): a block has positive sign when it comes from a nonsymmetric Galois orbit and negative sign when it comes from a symmetric Galois orbit.

This assignment gives a bijection from \(S(k)\)-conjugacy classes of maximal \(k\)-tori in \(S\) to signed partitions of \(r\).

For a unitary group \(U\) of type \({}^{2}A_{n-1}\), embedded in the associated symplectic group, the same construction gives a bijection from \(U(k)\)-conjugacy classes of maximal \(k\)-tori to signed partitions of \(n\) in which a part \(a\) has sign \((-1)^a\).
